actions.text: Own Windows geometry, HDRP and lighting realism. Close the runtime PairGate parity gap before calling a room pair study-valid.
Provide a Windows visual smoke of the current realism path and identify the next fidelity improvement only after the smoke is clean.
Use a clean Windows workspace from main. Verify author -> publish -> participant -> CSV and record demo-PC performance.
Keep the local Mac packaging work parked. Do not spend engineering time on Mac optimization until the Windows visual target is stable.
Choose the demo experiment, hypothesis, rating prompt and participant instructions. Review Windows screenshots or video and give a pass, conditional-pass or fail fidelity verdict.
Prove that a Mac can use the Windows PC as a GPU host: crisp video, responsive input and simple same-network setup. Research hourly cloud GPU only if this self-hosted route is not enough.

team_run.headline: Windows local demo first; Mac delivery is deferred
team_run.mac_status_meaning: Mac packaging and performance work are parked while the Windows visual target is stabilized. Mac teammates can still contribute through fidelity review, study design, and later streaming tests from the Windows GPU host.
team_run.mac_note: Do not run new Mac build or performance tests during the Windows-first phase.
